drafts.subject: Your Buzzwords talk on exactly-once billing events
drafts.body:
Hi Tomas, I watched your Berlin Buzzwords talk on exactly-once billing events.
Northwind Tools is hiring one engineer to own our billing service, and duplicate charges from event replays are the problem we most need solved.
Worth a reply?
Maya Chen, Head of Engineering, Northwind Tools
